research_question: Can causal 09:30-10:00 tick flow improve established YDAY-crash reclaim and gap-up confirmation strategies?
technical_corrections_before_performance: The first invocation failed in load_panel with KeyError open_0930 because the exact-clock merge duplicated a plan column. No selection, return, PnL, or output artifact was produced. The merge was restricted to open_1005, close_1555, and open_1600 before the first performance run.

data_contract.universe: quarterly PIT market-cap top500 intersected with daily PIT eligibility and ADV20 >= 10m; price >= 5; abs gap <= 30%
data_contract.precandidates: previous-day open-to-15:55 return <= -5% OR opening gap >= +2%
data_contract.signal_clock: only Polygon trades with SIP timestamp in [09:30,10:00) ET; tick-sign warmup may use [09:25,09:30)
data_contract.price_confirmation: 09:55 five-minute bar close divided by 09:30 open minus one, required > 0
data_contract.entry: exact 10:05 five-minute open, five minutes after signal cutoff
data_contract.exit: exact 15:55 close; if absent after selection, 16:00 open fallback; future exit availability never affects selection

variants.name: yday_reclaim_flow
variants.rule: price rule plus 30m flow >= 0.05 and last5 flow >= 0.05
variants.rank: prior loss times persistent flow strength

variants.name: yday_reclaim_acceleration
variants.rule: price rule plus last5-minus-first5 flow acceleration >= 0.25 and last5 flow > 0

variants.name: gapup_confirm_flow
variants.rule: price rule plus 30m flow >= 0.05 and last5 flow >= 0.05

portfolio.selection: up to three highest-ranked longs each day after exact-entry filtering and full refill
portfolio.sic_cap: maximum one ticker per SIC per day
portfolio.weight: 20% current NAV per name; maximum 0.6x gross

development_gate.winner: highest base-cost Sharpe then CAGR among passers

multiple_testing_policy: Exactly five frozen rows. Price-only rows are benchmarks. No post-result threshold, ranking, clock, exit, direction, or position-count changes.
production_policy: A validation pass permits further audit only, not production PASS.
